### [`bull_part_copy_unused`](../../../src/bull_sprites_e300.asm#L247) `$E5C0-$E5FF`

*data*

Unused block (pointer $97): a byte for byte copy of $e000 (v1 part $f6). No frame names $97. The bull blocks $eb-$f6 of v1 were copied as one run of 12, and frame 66 uses the copy at $e000.
